headline: Clausura Biancorojiblanca
content: Boys lost 2–1 to Binational in the 13th round of the Tournament Clausura, still hoping to stay in First Division. Despite leading initially through Carlos Neyra's goal (21'), Punjabi team turned around with goals from Milton Benites (49) and Yorkman Tello (79"). Sports Boy remains 13th in accumulated table with 47 points. Meanwhile, Cantolao defeated already relegated Comercial Union 2–0 thanks to Colombian Fabián Gonzalez’s brace (43', 54'). With this result, ‘the Dolphin’ secured its place in First Division."

author: NA
